Name: Caroline Swimsuit Anywhere
Author: Guibel664
Description:
This mod changes Caroline’s default outfit to a swimsuit in all locations and seasons.She will appear wearing her swimsuit indoors, outdoors, during events, and even in winter.

This mod replaces her regular character sprites (and portraits, if applicable) with the swimsuit version.

No events, dialogue, or gameplay mechanics are altered — this is a visual-only change.

Requires Content Patcher.

Manifest.Description: Now Caroline goes anywhere wearing only a swimsuit
